summary: Discussion of when the tour happened, mid-1930s, and what became of Mamie Smith.

blocks.x: Oh yeah, that was during the depression time. I didn't know what happened to her. I didn't know what happened to her. I never. Well, I didn't hear that she was. She settled in New York.
And I think married some fellow. Evidently had a lot of money and settled down on riverside drive or someplace up the river

there. Real nice place. I didn't hear that for around 1940. You hadn't been with her so long before that. No. It was around that. It was around that. It was around that. Yeah. It was around that. Yeah.
Yeah. It was around 30, 36 or 35, something like that. Yeah.
I didn't know that she was still active then because she made those real early records. Yes. About 1922 or 1925, I think she stopped recording. I thought maybe she just retired. I don't know.
That was around, that was around 35, 36.
